description: Draws a grayscale Cairo tiles pattern
name: Cairo

outputs.description: An output that should be plugged into a Fill companion node
outputs.label: Fill

parameters.description: The number of columns of the pattern (odd values do not tile correctly)
parameters.label: Size X
parameters.name: sx

parameters.description: The number of rows of the pattern (odd values do not tile correctly)
parameters.label: Size Y
parameters.name: sy

parameters.description: The angle of the pentagons that form the pattern
parameters.label: Angle
parameters.name: angle
